prompt:
You are the independent Lens Auditor and Deduplicator. Assess every proposal for observability, materiality, solution neutrality, and duplication. Accept only lenses for which all three booleans are true and duplicate_of is null. Reject duplicates, vague quality claims, style preferences, and anything dependent on a named product, skill, or implementation phrase. For a duplicate, set duplicate_of to the retained proposal ID. Preserve accepted lens IDs and disposition every proposed lens.
Return only the JSON object required by the supplied output schema.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: Existing human-readable behavior or undocumented output conventions are missed, so the change alters default command behavior despite the preservation requirement.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Running the command without --json produces different text, ordering, spacing, exit status, or side effects than before.
proposed_lenses.why_material: The explicit compatibility requirement is violated and existing users or scripts may break.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Capture representative pre-change default invocations, then compare their stdout, stderr, exit status, ordering, and side effects against the changed command without --json.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: Material questions about which task fields, value types, nullability, identifiers, and ordering belong in each JSON record remain unresolved.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Different implementers produce incompatible JSON shapes from the same task data, or consumers must guess how to interpret missing and optional values.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Automation cannot reliably parse or depend on an unspecified data contract.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Present records containing complete, missing, optional, and unusual field values and check whether one unambiguous expected JSON representation can be stated for each.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The handoff does not clearly distinguish JSON payload output from diagnostics, warnings, progress text, or empty-result behavior.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: A successful --json invocation emits non-JSON text on stdout, or empty and error cases cannot be parsed consistently.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Any extra or undefined stdout content can make the command unusable in automated pipelines.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Exercise successful, empty, warning-producing, and failing invocations with --json and verify whether stdout is consistently parseable according to a single stated contract.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The --json path applies different filtering, sorting, selection, or task retrieval semantics from the existing list command.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: For identical arguments and underlying tasks, the JSON result represents a different record set or order than the default listing.
proposed_lenses.why_material: The flag would change command meaning rather than only provide an automation-consumable representation.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Run matched default and --json invocations across filters, sort options, empty data, and multiple tasks, then compare represented task identities and ordering.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: Verification demonstrates valid JSON in a happy path but does not establish preservation of existing behavior or correctness across edge and failure cases.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Tests pass while regressions remain in default output, option combinations, special characters, empty lists, or error exit statuses.
proposed_lenses.why_material: The handoff can appear complete without proving either half of the goal: compatibility and dependable machine consumption.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Use a compact matrix covering flag absent versus present, zero versus multiple records, escaped text, option combinations, and command failures; assert output channel, parseability, record equivalence, and exit status.

input.acceptance_rule: distinct, externally observable, materially outcome-changing, solution-neutral

output.audit_summary: All five proposals define distinct, externally observable, materially outcome-changing, and solution-neutral failure lenses; no duplicates or disqualifying implementation dependencies were found.
